read.title: Re: PO #2417
read.text:
Dear Ms. Tanaka,

Thank you for your purchase order. We are pleased to confirm 4,000 units of our hydrating cream and 1,500 units of the cleansing foam.

However, we found one discrepancy. The PO lists the unit price of the cream as $3.20, but our latest quotation was $3.40. Could you double-check this and send us a revised PO?

Once we receive it, we will acknowledge the order and start production. The expected ship date is January 15.

Best regards,
Minsu Lee

write.task: 바이어가 보낸 발주서의 수량(5,000개)이 상담 때 이야기한 수량(6,000개)과 달라요. 주문에 감사하고, 수량을 다시 확인해 달라는 짧은 이메일을 써 보세요.
write.en: Thank a buyer for their PO and ask them to check the quantity, which differs from what you discussed.
write.model:
Dear Mr. Lopez,

Thank you for your purchase order. Before we confirm it, we noticed a discrepancy. The PO shows 5,000 units, but we discussed 6,000 units during our call. Could you double-check the quantity and let us know? We will acknowledge the order as soon as we hear from you.

Best regards,
Minsu Lee
